items.title: Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, company says
items.summary: During its busiest week last quarter, Uber said only 4 people booked a ride using an AI agent.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: Snapchat surpasses 30M paid subscribers
items.summary: The milestone comes a year after Snapchat announced a controversial limit on free storage for its Memories feature and informed users it would start requiring users to pay $1.99 per month for additional storage or subscribe to Snapchat+ to retain their Memories.
items.creator: Aisha Malik

items.title: OpenAI is already trying to shape the 2028 election
items.summary: OpenAI’s Chris Lehane wants AI to define the 2028 election, proposing a new social contract that could benefit Americans while also advancing the AI giant’s own business interests.
items.creator: Rebecca Bellan

items.title: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor
items.summary: The startup allows software engineers to deploy teams of agents to work on various aspects of a project simultaneously.
items.creator: Lucas Ropek
